name: C.Q.C. - Close Quarters Combat
summary: Fight in this action-packed and fun top-down shooter against hordes of zombies, complete objectives and blaze your trail in 4 different settings. Stand your ground with up to four players in a local split screen COOP match or fight against your friends in a variety of PvP maps.

name: CQ: Calling Any Station
summary: An idle/incremental game about a lone radio operator keying into a silent universe. Click or walk away, both work just as well. Build your station, log distant contacts, retune to grow stronger, and slowly decode what answers back.
